# Kaku Docs

> Scoped index for the Kaku documentation section. Kaku is an AI-friendly Mac terminal with sensible defaults, ready out of the box, derived from WezTerm, MIT licensed, with no account and no telemetry. Site-wide index: https://kaku.fun/llms.txt

Every page below has a markdown twin at the same URL with `.md` appended, served as `text/markdown`. Fetch those rather than the HTML when you only need the prose.

## When to read which page

- **Someone cannot install Kaku, or the `kaku` command is missing.** Start at [Install](https://kaku.fun/docs/index.md). It covers the DMG, the `tw93/tap/kakuku` Homebrew tap, `kaku doctor`, and shell integration recovery.
- **Someone is new and wants the tour.** [Guide](https://kaku.fun/docs/guide.md) walks first launch through tabs, panes, the shell suite, and the assistant in plain language.
- **A question about what Kaku can do.** [Features](https://kaku.fun/docs/features.md) is the authoritative list: Kaku Assistant, AI chat panel, window snapshots, AppleScript, Lazygit, Yazi, remote files, and the shell suite.
- **A `kaku` subcommand question, or scripting Kaku.** [CLI Reference](https://kaku.fun/docs/cli.md) documents `kaku ai`, `chat`, `config`, `doctor`, `update`, `reset`, `init`, and `kaku cli` for driving the multiplexer from scripts.
- **Changing a setting.** [Configuration](https://kaku.fun/docs/configuration.md) covers font, opacity, Smart Tab, close confirmation, and Lua overrides in `~/.config/kaku/kaku.lua`.
- **A shortcut question, or rebinding keys.** [Keybindings](https://kaku.fun/docs/keybindings.md) has the full default table plus the `config.keys` append pattern.
- **A short factual question about install, comparisons, platform support, or licensing.** [FAQ](https://kaku.fun/docs/faq.md) usually answers it in one paragraph.
- **Building from source or opening a pull request.** [Contributing](https://kaku.fun/docs/contributing.md).
